snippet.title: Chop Suey: Gameplay
snippet.description:
Chop Suey (c) English Software Company 1985 & (c) Antic Software 1985 for the Atari 8 bit line of computers

A less serious, more arcade-like-feeling karate fighting game, with much less strategy and tactics involved than e.g. International Karate / World Karate Championship. Also, there are only four attacking moves, if I count correctly. The controls are tight, for the most part, though turning around by pushing FIRE button is too slow, mostly.

It was definitely a popular game with me and my friends, when we were kids, and we fondly battled it out a bunch of times in this game.

Using the Atari800Win PLus emulator (http://www.a800win.atari-area.prv.pl) with standard Atari 800XL settings (XL/XE / 64kB RAM / PAL mode).

00:00 Title screen & music
00:37 SLOW mode
04:13 FAST mode
